Ava Chen (CEO): Good morning team — quick weekly from my side.

Ava Chen (CEO): Highlights: 1) Hosted API latency improved 12% week-over-week after the kernel tuning rollouts. 2) First Dedicated contract signed with OrionHealth. 3) Private beta for EU region onboarding started.

Ava Chen (CEO): Key metrics (last 7d):
- MRR: $1.42M (up 6%)
- Avg API p95 latency: 142ms (down from 162ms)
- Error rate (generation): 0.8% (stable)
- Dedicated utilization: 78% (we're near target)

Ava Chen (CEO): Top priorities next 7 days:
1) Finish auto-fallback routing logic to reduce customer-visible errors (eng)
2) Ramp Dedicated capacity for OrionHealth onboarding (operations + SRE)
3) Ship v0.3 of Optimize with new batching suggestions (product + ML)

Ava Chen (CEO): Asks:
- Diego: please confirm the fallback rollout window and if we need a canary.
- Maya: confirm Optimize release notes and any customer-facing copy.
- Finance: check if we can extend the credit line for short-term spike capacity.
- People Ops: can we reschedule the town hall to Wed 11am PT? I have a conflict.

Ava Chen (CEO): FYI: I'll be on customer calls Monday afternoon for OrionHealth; Diego or Maya, please be the escalation contact if anything blocks the rollout.

Diego Morales (VP Eng): Ack. We'll target a gradual canary starting Tue 02:00 UTC, ramp over 3 hours. I'll post the rollout playbook.

Maya Patel (VP Product): Noted. We'll freeze copy until we validate regressions on the new quant profiles. ETA EOD Tue.

Samir Rao (Head of Finance): Finance is okay with a short-term credit bump; will send updated numbers to leadership by EOD.

Elena Gomez (People Ops): Town hall: Wed 11am PT conflicts with onboarding demo. Suggest Thu 10am PT — does that work for execs?

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary for fallback-routing v2 started by diego — canary id c-9831 — tracking at https://dashboard.internal/redwood/canaries/c-9831

Diego Morales (VP Eng): dropping the playbook here:
``
- Start canary Tue 02:00 UTC
- Monitor p99 latency + generation errors for 30m
- If stable, 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 hours
- Rollback trigger: >1.5x baseline error rate or sustained p99 > 2x baseline
```

Maya Patel (VP Product): Thanks, Diego. I'll coordinate with support for the customer comms.

Ava Chen (CEO): Thanks everyone. Short sync Mon 9am PT for leadership; otherwise enjoy the weekend. :rocket:
